stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, United Strength Power Holdings Limited primarily focuses on managing vehicle natural gas refueling stations throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's offerings encompass a variety of fuels, including refined oil, compressed natural gas (CNG), liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and liquefied natural gas (LNG). Additionally, it engages in the wholesale trade of LPG, LNG, and associated chemical products, while also providing transportation services for petroleum and gas. By the close of 2021, specifically December 31st, the firm maintained a network of 94 refueling stations across Northeastern China. Beyond its commercial ventures, United Strength Power Holdings Limited is also involved in the advancement of energy technologies. Founded in 1997, the company's central operations are based in Changchun, PRC. It is a part of Golden Truth Holdings Limited, functioning as its subsidiary.
